summary:
Wizard FS.GG.NewSddWorkspace **0.23.1** was published on 2026-10-30 from source `e922a7c6`, the merge of .github#4966 (reviewed head `5c80bbb9`, tree identical). It repairs the default-coordination defect of the published 0.23.0 and supersedes 0.23.0 as the current Wizard; 0.23.0 and its journal `board-v2-product-creator-023` stay immutable history. Root admitted it under the user ruling recorded on .github#3010 and tracked it in .github#4964.

**Defect repaired.** 0.23.0 with default coordination wrote `securityObligations` into the SDD-owned `.fsgg/scaffold-provenance.json`; SDD CLI 2.5.3 validates that file strictly, so `fsgg-sdd doctor` reported `isCoherent:false` (`scaffold.provenanceMalformed`, Unknown property) on all four catalog providers. 0.23.1 stores the Wizard's own state in Wizard-owned files: `.fsgg/security-obligations.json` (schema `fsgg.new-sdd-workspace-security-obligations/1`; `securityObligations` and `verifiedSecurityReceipts`, rows unchanged) and `.fsgg/coordination-retrofits.json`. The next `secure`, `retrofit` or `--upgrade` run migrates the members 0.23.0 wrote into provenance (idempotent, crash-safe, Wizard-owned row wins). The selected-product V2 route still records `productBoard` in provenance and is unchanged.

**Kit pin.** The coordination kit is no longer read from moving `main`: `coordination-kit-pin.json` names `FS-GG/.github` commit `a9a6f77f` and sha256 anchors (generated skill manifest, `fsgg-coord` shim, tool manifest); a digest mismatch refuses the kit and writes nothing from it, an unfetchable file still warns. The embedded `initialize-sdd-workspace` skill stays authoritative (excluded via the pin's `embeddedSkills`), so creation, `--upgrade` and `retrofit` never restore the older pinned copy; `scripts/new-sdd-workspace-kit-pin.py check` guards that.

**Runs:** candidate 41085337428/a1 (artifact 12992231429, package `a84e6614…` with 93 entries, producer payload `c1d9b9f8…`, qualification `fsgg.creator0231-release-qualification/1`), preflight 41086734028/a1, publisher 41088019847/a1 (recorded deviation as for 0.23.0: `verify_nuget_login=false` after a passing preflight). All eight effects verified at generation 17 on the fresh journal `board-v2-product-creator-0231`. Release 429241547 (promoted, not latest; `coherent-set/v0.113.0` keeps that); tag `new-sdd-workspace/v0.23.1` -> `e922a7c6`. nuget.org lists 0.23.1 (2026-10-30T16:19:43Z); its archive `cc36936e…` holds the 93 candidate entries plus only `.signature.p7s`. The GitHub feed rests on the journal observation (`preparedArchiveEqual`, `producerPayloadEqual` true) plus the identical release asset. Dependencies are the same genuine promoted coherent **0.113.0** pin as 0.23.0 (release 421880935, source `79db622f`); `KNOWN_GRAPH_SEAL` `15fb4497…`.

**Installed acceptance (the four-provider default-coordination rerun, accepted by Root on .github#4964, comment 6528912322):** 0.23.1 installed from nuget.org (isolated configuration and cache) in the contained no-credential carrier (no `gh`, no token, read-only mount); the installed package sha equals the nuget.org nupkg and its entries equal the release asset. TypeScript, JavaScript, Rust and Go CLI creations with default coordination: `doctor.isCoherent:true` with no diagnostics, both obligations pending in `.fsgg/security-obligations.json` (never claimed verified), provenance free of the moved keys, kit byte-identical to `a9a6f77f`, the embedded initialize skill, idempotent `retrofit`, and migration of the workspace created by the published 0.23.0 to coherent. 82 of 82 checks; receipts manifest `2e6a4afb9703c95e507e7652523d1f5577658c1e01e0eeea63d21e5b07ce4a00` in private custody.

**Limits:** the GitHub Packages feed bytes were not read directly; one Linux x64 contained carrier; no reproducibility pack; independent custody of the advisory inputs is owed. The V2 `productBoard` route was not re-qualified. A pending repository obligation whose target is the placeholder `repository-not-yet-created` is not cleared by a `secure --repo` resume (unchanged since 0.23.0).

**Template:** the Wizard describes published FS.GG.Workspace.Template **0.20.1** (tag `fs-gg-templates/v0.20.1`, payload `7c48b222…`). The 0.23.0 record and its journal remain the history of that publication.
